title: CI: GitHub Actions build for iOS, Android, Linux, macOS, Windows
description: GitHub Actions workflow that builds Flutter app for all 5 targets on every push to main. iOS: uses macos-latest runner + Xcode, produces .ipa. Android: uses ubuntu-latest + Android SDK, produces .apk. Linux: ubuntu-latest, produces .deb/.AppImage. macOS: macos-latest, produces .dmg. Windows: windows-latest, produces .msix. Artifacts attached to GitHub releases. Optional: Codemagic for App Store / Play Store deployment.
